title: pm-dispatch: retire the old L2 seat spelling review#N and its stubs after one seat cycle; rename the L2 scripts
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jSnGTcRAGCDp8LNU7H

Follow-up of #34021 (PR #34052): that card keeps the old names readable for one cycle; this card carries their retirement. #34021 keeps everything else.

Filing gate ③: maintainer-directed — the rename the maintainer ruled on 2026-11-15 (ruling record on #34021, comment 6897685514) was to be done 「一步到位」; the aliases exist only so running seats, open PRs and posted records do not break mid-cycle.

## Items

1. Retire the old L2 seat word `review` and seat spelling `review#N` from every reader PR #34052 taught both spellings: `SEAT_BARE_LANES` and `L2_REVIEW_LANE_WORDS` (`scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`), the signature lane alternation (`SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE`, `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`), `HANDOFF_TARGET` (`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`), the roster title token (`scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs`), and `check-owed-reviews.mjs`. Flip each both-spelling self-test case to refuse the old one.
2. Delete the two one-line stubs `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/review.md` and `references/review-checklist.md`, and their ratchet rows; drop the alias sentence in `lanes/l2-review.md`.
3. Rename `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` and `scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs` (both are L2-only tools whose names say only "review"), with `package.json` wiring and every reference moved in the same PR.
4. Noted by the #34021 dev: `check-owed-reviews.mjs` still bars an L2 seat on the PR's own account (`reviewSeatsOf`, `isBarred`). Once PR #33938 lands, check that this agrees with the L2 charter text and fix whichever side is wrong.

## Restart-when

Items 1–2 start only after one full seat cycle in which no open seat post, mailbox PR or seat signature spells `review#N`, and no new comment writes it. Measure with `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` and a comment search over that cycle. Items 3 and 4 may go first.
